columns.name: RUN_MSG_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies a subscription message row.

columns.name: PARENT_MSG_ID
columns.description: Entry Identifier. Foreign Key to HRC_SUBSCRIPTION_QUEUE.RUN_MSG_ID

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Updated entry timestamp. Can be set to a future time.

columns.name: PUBLISHED
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the creation of the entry.

columns.name: QUEUEING_STATUS
columns.description: Determines the queueing status of the activity run. Valid values are NEW, READY, QUEUED DELIVERED

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.description: Determines the queueing status of the activity run. Valid values are NEW, CHECKING, RETRY, SUCCESS, ERROR

columns.name: STATUS_DETAILS
columns.description: Determines the status details of the processing. Valid values are QUEUEING_STATUS, PROCESSING_STATUS

columns.name: NO_OF_RETRIES
columns.description: Determines for number times the message is verified for a successful status.

columns.name: NEXT_RETRY_TIME
columns.description: Determines the time when a retry can occur.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
